description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-09-09)

### ✨ New Features

* d0nj Patches — Niagara Launcher (unlock Pro, remove analytics), AI Audio Novel Reader (unlock premium) ([edd7c8f](https://github.com/d0nj/morphe-patches/commit/edd7c8f6e5dc16ffe72186bb322330818da15a48))

patches.name: Remove analytics
patches.description: Disables all telemetry in Niagara Launcher: the weekly usage-report upload (app launches, notification metadata, survey responses), retention milestone events, GDPR consent sync, Singular attribution sessions and events (advertising ID, app set ID, install referrer, FCM token) and the runtime Firebase Analytics opt-in.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Makes the entitlement holder always report Pro in Niagara Launcher. Unlocks all Pro features and bypasses the 7-day trial prompt. Server-backed features (account sync, Stripe checkout) are not affected.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Makes isPremium() always return true in AI Audio Novel Reader. Unlocks all premium features and disables the 10-hour trial countdown.
